title: Swakudya Swa Nkulukumba Leswi Nga Langutekiki
intro: Eka tindhawu to kwetsima ta Yindlu ya Allah, nandza wa Xikwembu la dyuhaleke u vone xihundla lexikulu lexi a xi tlula hinkwaswo leswi a swi languteriwile. Munhu loyi la tinyiketeleke, khale swinene ku tlula malembe ya vutswari bya ntumbuluko, u vone nchumu lowu nga tolovelekangiki lowu paluxeke tintswalo leti nga riki na swipimelo ta Vukwembu. Xiphiqo xi le ku paluxeni ka nkarhi lowu lowu rivariweke ku suka evuton’wini bya vaprofeta.
clues: Vanhu va mina a va tiviwa tanihi Israyele, vatukulu va mupatriyarka lonkulu wa khale.
Ndzi hete vusiku bya mina ndzi ri eku khongeleni, ndzi nkhinsama emahlweni ka Hosi ya mina etempeleni.
Ndzi nyikiwe n’wana wa mufana loko ndzi dyuharile, nyiko leyi ndzi nga tshikangiki ku dzunisa Allah ha yona.
Ndzingo wa mina a wu katsa ku kuma swakudya leswi humeleleke eka moya-xiviri lowuntshwa lowu a wu ri ehansi ka nkhathalelo wa mina.
A ndzi ri muprofeta la vuriwaka Zakariyya, loyi a nyikiweke ntirho wo khathalela Maryam eBayt al-Maqdis.
Nhlamulo yi le ka ndzimana leyi Allah a amukeleke Maryam ivi a n’wi nyika swakudya.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
